newsitem.title: CANADA: Ballard stock up on expected investment.
newsitem.headline: Ballard stock up on expected investment.

text.p: Ballard Power Systems Inc shares rose 1.35 to 29.75 Wednesday on expectations the Canadian government will announce plans to invest C$30 million in the high-tech company, traders said.
Canadian Prime Minister Jean Chretien was expected to announce the funding later Wednesday when he attends the opening of Ballard's new headquarters in Vancouver.
Media reports said the C$30 million would be paid back to the federal government through royalties based on future sales of Ballard's fuel cells.
